Mainstage 60 minutes Saturday, September 26, 2026 – 10:30 pm NY - 14TH ST. Mainstage A sketch comedy show made in ONE day, featuring New York’s best comedy writers and performers! Once a month, we cram together New York’s best writers and performers to craft an ALL-NEW sketch comedy show from scratch IN ONE SINGLE DAY! We start the day at 9am with NOTHING, but a show is going up by the end of the night whether we’re ready or not! Sketch Cram is all the comedy you can cram into a single show, featuring writers and performers from some of your favorite shows, bringing you 100% NEW CONTENT EVERY MONTH! So grab a ticket, and cram your butt into a seat! It’s Sketch Cram time, baby! SKETCH CRAM IS PRODUCED, DIRECTED AND WRITTEN BY: Georgie Aldaco ( Inside Amy Schumer, Miracle Workers [TBS], Koala Man [Hulu]) Jared Bronen ( Just for Laughs, New York Comedy Festival, CollegeHumor) Alex Guaglianone (Maude Night, Just For Laughs, Nicholl Fellowship Finalist, Austin Screenplay Finalist) Stacey Kulow ( Maude Night, Austin Sketch Fest, Buffy the Gilmore Slayer Podcast ) Hunter Nelson ( The Onion, The Truth, ASSSSKETCH ) Rachel Taenzler ( Harold Night, PAGE Awards Finalist, Bratz Mash at UCB ) THIS MONTH’S GUESTS… WRITERS: Tim Daly (Maude Night, “The Dump” Podcast) Josh Ellman ( Maude Night, New York Queer Comedy Festival Finalist, Ghost Stories) Fu Goto (Harold Night, Maude Night) Zoe Johnson ( ASSSSKETCH, Maude Night, Queer Window, SF SketchFest, DC SketchFest) David Saliterman (Maude Night, The Bowery Review) ACTORS: Trumane Alston ( Gethard & Trumane, Shamilton! The Improvised Hip Hop Musical, Fat Ham at the Goodman Theater) Whitney Bae ( UCB, Black Improv Alliance, OG YouTuber) Sam Blake (Magnet Theater, Playhouse West) Ryan Chittaphong ( Asian AF, Story Pirates, Stella Adler Studio) Malika Ray ( 2024 UCB X SNL Diversity Scholarship Program Winner, Maude Night) Austin Rye ( Second City Theatricals, Characters Welcome, Lloyd Night) Julia Schroeder ( Maude Night, Netflix is a Joke Festival, New York Comedy Festival, Screamboat) Rachel Taenzler ( Harold Night, PAGE Awards Finalist, Bratz Mash at UCB ) WITH A VIDEO BY: Andrew Bourne (NoBudge, Vice , Tribeca Film Festival, Outfest) — In-person tickets are $20 plus fees. All sales are final. The show starts at the time listed. If you are not at the theater more than 5 minutes before the start of the show, we may release your tickets to the waitlist. Lineup is subject to change. Under 17 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian. Please use discretion, as all our shows can potentially use adult/sexual material, language, and images.
